display.title: Episode 394: The Two Brothers (Elul)
display.summary_short: The shofar of Elul calls us to help people whose souls are hungry, Shema with a second-grader from the Bronx, and the story of two brothers whose love chose the place of the Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Elul 5749, the week before Chai Elul. Uncle Yossi explains that the daily shofar of Elul is like a bugle calling the soldiers of Tzivos Hashem to attention before Rosh Hashanah. To deserve a good year, he suggests the mitzvah of Ahavas Yisroel: a person can have plenty of food and clothing and still be very poor, because the soul's food is Torah and its clothing and shelter are mitzvos. Children are asked to help a friend or relative join a yeshiva, with Tzivos Hashem's help. After the Hakochainik march, a seven-year-old girl from a Bronx Bais Yaakov visits Studio 604 with her parents to lead the Shema. Story time tells of two farmer brothers, one with a large family and one alone, who each secretly carry wheat to the other's field at midnight and meet on top of the mountain. Hashem chose that spot, Har HaMoriah, for the Beis HaMikdash. The show ends with yeshiva enrollment information, Shabbos candle times and a reminder that Chai Elul is the birthday of the Baal Shem Tov and the Alter Rebbe.
display.lesson: Love and help each other like brothers, and help others feed their souls with Torah and mitzvos.

date.note: 'Next Monday, that's the 18th of September... Chai Elul' places the Tuesday show on 12 Sep 1989; shofar of Elul already being blown.
